title: Integration Testing for Applications knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Integration Testing for Applications”?
options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.

Integration Testing for Applications links the database to application behavior. Reuse official driver patterns, keep the client lifecycle and connection configuration explicit, parameterize user-driven inputs through driver APIs, and test timeout and error paths.
